description: Result returned by the JS-owned WYSIWYG remote operation batch patcher.

members.name: Failed
members.description: Creates a failed result for a specific operation or bridge failure.

members.name: Applied
members.description: Number of operations applied to the live DOM.

members.name: FailedOperationIds
members.description: Operation ids that could not be applied.

members.name: Queued
members.description: Number of operations queued because the editor is still inside a local input transaction.

members.name: Skipped
members.description: Number of operations skipped because their operation id was already applied.

members.name: Success
members.description: Whether all operations in the batch were applied or skipped as already applied.
